sara-ng: Auditor asked for exportable evidence of KMS envelope access patterns across service accounts for ISO — wants a sampling statement + signed manifest. Short on time, any quick runbook?

mike-ops: we can pull CloudTrail events for GenerateDataKey/Decrypt filtered by requestParameters.keyId (envelope) and userIdentity.principalId. Splunk/BQ export exists. I'll sketch a query.

devsec-carlos: prefer a deterministic sample: 1) export 30-day CloudTrail for the KMS key ARNs in scope, 2) dedupe by envelope id, 3) stratify by service account, weekday, and hour buckets. That gives a reproducible representative set.

mike-ops: example BQ query to start (adapt for Splunk):
```sql
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId AS principal, JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(requestParameters, '$.keyId') AS envelope_arn, sourceIPAddress
FROM `prod_logs.cloudtrail_events`
WHERE eventName IN ('GenerateDataKey','Decrypt')
  AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(requestParameters, '$.keyId') LIKE 'arn:aws:kms:%:key/%'
  AND eventTime BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
ORDER BY eventTime DESC
LIMIT 10000;
```

infra-bot: export job started: cloudtrail-export-prod -> gs://redwood-compliance/iso_evidence/kms_envelopes/1769999999/ (ETA ~12m) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

auditor-jen: we need a signed sampling assertion — can product redact PII (IPs), and include the sampling method (random seed + stratification) in the manifest?

sara-ng: yes. plan: provide manifest.jsonl (one line per sampled envelope) with fields + sampling_reason + SHA256 checksum per line, and a GPG-signed manifest.sha256.sig from security. PII: we'll mask IPs to /24 as discussed.

devsec-carlos: manifest fields to include: envelope_arn, first_seen, last_seen, principal, service, event_count, sample_bucket, sha256_hex, sample_method. Example line for the auditor cover: 
```
envelope_arn=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd1234 | first_seen=2026-02-05T12:03:00Z | last_seen=2026-03-10T08:12:10Z | principal=svc-order-processor@redwood | service=orders | events=47 | sample_bucket=weekday-daytime | sha256_hex=3f7a...
```

mike-ops: we'll drop full encryptionContext blobs from the export but include a redacted summary field if required. Also adding a short control mapping snippet linking this evidence to ISO 27001 A.12.4.1 (logging) and SOC2 CC6.1 (logical access) in the evidence README.

sara-ng: RBAC change note to include in bundle: role `kms:EnvelopeReaders` modified on 2026-03-01 to add `svc-ingest`; change captured in PR #5123 and deploy record `deploy-2026-03-01-09`.

auditor-jen: confirm retention windows and chain of custody — need SHA256 hashes and a timestamped signature. Also want a short statement that sampling is non-destructive and reproducible.

infra-bot: checksum manifest uploaded: gs://redwood-compliance/iso_evidence/kms_envelopes/1769999999/manifest.sha256
signature: gs://redwood-compliance/iso_evidence/kms_envelopes/1769999999/manifest.sha256.sig
export_finish_time=2026-03-15T15:22:30Z

devsec-carlos: vulnerability triage note: one event flagged where `svc-old-ingest` used a deprecated key policy (missing condition on kms:ViaService). Created vuln ticket `VULN-2026-87`, assigned to mike-ops, added to manifest as remediation_entry.

mike-ops: ack. I'll rotate that key with a planned maintenance window and backfill logs to prove no gaps. ETA for rotation and evidence: 2026-03-18. Will attach PR + rotation audit in the bundle.

sara-ng: I'll assemble a one-page auditor cover: scope, exact queries, sample method (seed=42, stratification buckets), redaction rules, hashes, RBAC changelist, vuln follow-ups, and chain-of-custody links. Posting draft in #eng-security for sign-off and will send signed bundle to the auditor once infra confirms checksums.

auditor-jen: perfect — please @me when draft is ready. :thumbsup:
